Welcome to the nf-core config creation wizard
This app will help you create
configs for defining computing environment for all pipelines, and
configs for defining pipeline-specific resource requirements
The resulting config file can be used with a pipeline with adding
They can also be added to the centralised
repository, where they can be used
directly by anyone running nf-core pipelines on your infrastructure specifying
